morning4_start.name: {name}
morning4_start.text: *Day four. Weekend. — No school today. It's a date.*

morning4_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_seo.text: *The alarm rings. A message from Seoyeon is waiting on my phone.*

morning4_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_yuna.text: *The alarm rings. A message from Yuna is waiting on my phone.*

morning4_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_dain.text: *The alarm rings. A message from Dain is waiting on my phone.*

minsu_cheer_1.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_1.text: *I check my phone. Morning message. — Minsu's at the top.*

minsu_cheer_1_d.name: Minsu
minsu_cheer_1_d.text: *Dain posted in the group chat. Said she had plans tomorrow.*

minsu_cheer_4_ins_single.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_ins_single.text: *I check my phone calendar. I have only one date today.*

minsu_cheer_4_c.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_c.text: *I check my phone calendar. Seoyeon in the morning, Yuna in the afternoon, Dain in the evening. I didn't sleep last night trying to fit all three into one day. If even one schedule overlaps, it's over.*

minsu_cheer_4_e.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_e.text: *I take a deep breath and check the date messages again.*

morning4_start_2.name: {name}
morning4_start_2.text: *I take a deep breath and check the messages again.*

morning4_seo_msg_1.name: Seoyeon
morning4_seo_msg_1.text: Don't be late. The fountain in the park, ten o'clock.

morning4_seo_msg_1_c.name: {name}
morning4_seo_msg_1_c.text: *I stand in front of the fountain. The clock reads 9:58.*

morning4_yuna_msg_1.name: Yuna
morning4_yuna_msg_1.text: 10 a.m. Cafe by the station. If you're late, I'm gone.

morning4_yuna_msg_1_b.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_1_b.text: *Short. Very Yuna. There's no period after 'If you're late, I'm leaving.'*

morning4_yuna_msg_single.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_single.text: *The message is short. It's my only date today.*

morning4_dain_msg_1.name: Dain
morning4_dain_msg_1.text: Today's the day. In front of the gym at six. Why am I so nervous? Should I even send this?

morning4_fallback_msg.name: {name}
morning4_fallback_msg.text: *Weekend morning. A few notifications are waiting. — I thought it would be an ordinary day. I set down my phone and stretch. Either way, another day begins.*

morning4_hidden_check.name: {name}
morning4_hidden_check.text: *Weekend. I end up passing by the school.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.text: *My steps stop for a moment, and then I keep walking past.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1.text: *The school gate is slightly open, and someone is moving inside. The homeroom teacher comes out carrying a paper bag.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1_b.text: *My feet stop at the front gate. A beat late, the teacher hides the paper envelope behind her back.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3.text: What are you doing at school on a weekend?

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_b.text: I came for the literature club critique. I brought my manuscript too.

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_c.text: *One corner of the teacher's paper envelope is folded.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_e.text: Today was the only time the students who signed up were free. Their advisor has to be there.

hidden_homeroom_d4_4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_4.text: *The homeroom teacher keeps the paper bag in one hand.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_4_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_4_d.text: Students don't usually peek through the school gate when they're just passing by.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5.text: The literature club members went ahead to a café nearby. Want to sit in on the critique?

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_b.text: Is it okay if I come?

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_c.text: It's an open critique, so that's fine. But whether you read the manuscript is up to you.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_d.text: *Even after finishing, the teacher keeps folding the corner of the cup holder.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.text: *The corner of the paper envelope is pressed under the cup holder.*
choices: Sure. May I sit in on the critique?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.text: The club members are at a table in the back. Rumors that we came alone would spread faster than my manuscript.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_b.text: I was just about to say the same thing.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_c.text: *She takes a sip of coffee.* Good. Then we're on the same page.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_d.text: *The teacher says it like a joke and touches the coffee cup. Two circular water rings overlap on the coaster.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_e.text: Which part are you showing the club?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_f.text: *She sets down her coffee cup, her fingers lingering on the handle.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.text: The opening, for now. I'm still most worried about how the characters sound.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_b.text: Will my comments be part of the critique too?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_c.text: I'll collect the comments without names. What matters isn't who said it, but where the story lost them.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_d.text: *The corner of a manuscript envelope shows from the teacher's bag. The folded part is a little dark with finger marks.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_e.text: Do you know the hardest part of a critique?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.text: Hearing where someone stopped reading instead of what they liked. It hurts the most—and helps the most.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.text: *The teacher sets down her coffee cup. Her body leans slightly toward the window.*
choices: You still haven't decided on the ending?
You'll show the whole thing to the club too, right?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.text: I still haven't settled on the ending. Every time I try to make it impressive, I ruin it.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.text: Of course. These are the copies I'm handing out today. There isn't a separate version just for you.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4.text: Could you mark anything that feels odd from a student's perspective? I'll consider your notes alongside everyone else's.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_b.text: *She keeps folding the corner of the cup sleeve.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_b.text: *She lets out a quiet laugh. Her hand stops folding the cup sleeve.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_c.text: Thanks. You don't have to put your name on it. It's anonymous, so mark it honestly.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_d.text: Does this count as work too?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_e.text: Let's call it advising the literature club today.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_f.text: *At the table in the back, a club member takes another copy of the manuscript.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_g.text: And we'll only discuss the manuscript during club time. I won't mix it into class or counseling.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_h.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_h.text: *She numbers each copy and sends the last one to the table in the back.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.text: Let's hold the next critique in the school library. We chose today's venue in too much of a rush.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_b.text: *After checking the bill with the club members, she heads back toward school first.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.text: All right. Your plans come first. I'll get formal feedback on the manuscript at school.

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_b.text: *Checking the literature club group chat, she heads back inside the school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.text: *On the morning set aside to prepare for the school event, I open the nurse's office door at my scheduled counseling time. A counseling form and an information sheet lie in front of the nurse.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_3.text: Right on time. Have a seat.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.text: *She opens the counseling form and picks up her pen.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.text: We're wrapping up our last session, right?

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.text: Right. We'll check how you're doing today and decide where you can go for help next time.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.text: *She goes through the items she wrote down during our last session, one by one.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_8.text: I need to check one thing.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.text: *She turns the school counseling information sheet toward {name}.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_11.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_11.text: Have you decided on an adult you can ask for help besides me?

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.text: *The sheet lists the order: homeroom teacher, school counseling center, then parent or guardian.*
choices: I'll talk to my homeroom teacher and the counseling center too.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice_a.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice_a.text: I'll talk to my homeroom teacher and the counseling center too.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_12.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_12.text: Good. That's much better than trying to endure it alone.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.text: I won't pass your story around carelessly. But if I think you're in danger of being hurt, I'll bring in another adult right away. Let's agree on that now.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.text: *She closes the counseling form.* You remember the order we wrote down today, right? If you feel lost, start with the first person on the list.
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.context: Day 4. The moment of farewell when asking if she'll come back after graduation. The scene where both show their true hearts. Tone: Deeper, more emotional conversation. Truth behind the playfulness. The meaning of being called by name.
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is careful and honest. She wants to call out your name but is in a cautious position. Tears come at your promise.

hidden_nurse_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_1.text: *An event first-aid kit and examination supplies are stacked on one side of the desk. The nurse looks up from labeling them.*

hidden_nurse_d4_1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_1_b.text: *She turns around.* Huh? You actually came?

hidden_nurse_d4_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2.text: I asked for volunteers to assemble the event first-aid kits, but I didn't think you'd actually sign up.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_b.text: So today I'm a volunteer, not a patient.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_c.text: A volunteer today. If you get hurt, you go back to being a patient.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_d.text: *As event staff come and go, we lay out gauze and alcohol swabs by type across the table.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_e.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_e.text: *She hands me an empty pouch.* Two gauze pads and three alcohol swabs in each. I'll handle any paperwork with personal information.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_f.text: *I fill each pouch with supplies. The nurse checks every finished kit again.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_g.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_g.text: ...At the university hospital, I used to do all this by myself.

hidden_nurse_d4_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4.text: ...At the university hospital, I used to do all this alone. On some night shifts, I did the work of three nurses by myself.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_c.text: *She pauses and sets down the papers.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_d.text: ...The hardest part back then wasn't the workload.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_f.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_f.text: The hardest part was when I started checking bed numbers before names. I couldn't even tell who I was looking at anymore.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_g.text: *The hand on the document no longer moves.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_h.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_h.text: At school, I have time to see students one at a time. And when something is beyond me, taking them to someone who can help is part of my job too.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_i.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_i.text: Does connecting someone with help count as treatment?

hidden_nurse_d4_4_j.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_j.text: So if you hit a wall here, go to your homeroom teacher or the counseling center too. Don't carry it alone.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_k.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_k.text: *She zips the final first-aid kit closed. Outside, other volunteers carry away the completed boxes.*

hidden_nurse_d4_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_5.text: That's why I came to a school. I wanted to relearn how to listen before trying to treat anything.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.text: *The nurse writes down the number of completed first-aid kits.*
choices: When are you glad you became a school nurse?
What's the biggest difference between a hospital and a school?

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.text: When a student who's been suffering alone opens that door on their own. That's when I know I chose well.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.text: Here, I can talk to someone before they get hurt. That's the biggest difference.

hidden_nurse_d4_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6.text: Thanks. I finished much faster because of you. ...It's nothing special.

hidden_nurse_d4_6_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6_c.text: It does matter. And I'll make sure every minute of your volunteer time is recorded.

hidden_nurse_d4_6_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_6_d.text: *The nurse writes the start and end times on the volunteer form.*

hidden_nurse_d4_choice.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_choice.text: All that's left is labeling them. The event staff are going to buy snacks—anyone want to help finish up?
choices: I'll stay and label the first-aid kits too.
That's okay, I should get going

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.text: *I stop by the snack shop in front of school with the event staff. There are enough takeout bags for everyone.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.text: Who picked the spicy one? Get some water first.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_b.text: You're the one who tried it first.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_c.text: I had to test it. *She takes a drink of water.* Not even a first-aid kit can save this.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.text: *We return to the nurse's office with the staff and label the kit boxes.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2.text: You look different now than when you talk about the hospital.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_b.text: *Her hand pauses midway through applying a label.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.text: I appreciate that, but don't make my feelings your responsibility.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_b.text: *She presses the final label into the center of the box.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_c.text: All right, that's it. Check your volunteer hours, then everyone back to the event site.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_d.text: *As I'm about to leave, the nurse calls me back with the form in her hand.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4.text: {name}. Thanks for helping today. Check your volunteer hours on Monday.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_b.text: *She hands the completed first-aid kit box to the teacher in charge of the event.*

hidden_nurse_d4_pass.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_pass.text: All right. Coming in on a weekend was more than enough. Get home safe.

morning4_end.name: {name}
morning4_end.text: *One more glance in the mirror. — Good enough. Let's go.*
